description: Source code for the SimplePlayer class in Android's stagefright media framework, handling media playback including setup, decoding, and audio rendering.

classes.name: SimplePlayer
classes.description: A media player class that handles media data source setup, decoding, and audio playback.

methods.name: PostAndAwaitResponse
methods.description: Posts a message and waits for a response, returning status.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the media data source from a file path.

methods.name: setSurface
methods.description: Sets the rendering surface for video output.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the media for playback, initializing extractors and codecs.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the player to initial state, releasing resources.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages for player commands.

methods.name: onPrepare
methods.description: Performs media extraction and codec configuration.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles starting playback, scheduling media processing.

methods.name: onReset
methods.description: Handles resetting the player state and releasing resources.

methods.name: onDoMoreStuff
methods.description: Performs periodic media processing, decoding, and audio rendering.

methods.name: onOutputFormatChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in output format from codecs, especially for audio.

methods.name: renderAudio
methods.description: Outputs decoded audio buffers to AudioTrack for playback.
